tests.name: range
tests.template: {% for i in (0..3) %}{{ i }} {% endfor %}

tests.name: array from context
tests.template: {% for tag in product.tags %}{{ tag }} {% endfor %}

tests.name: array, reversed
tests.template: {% for tag in product.tags | reverse %}{{ tag }} {% endfor %}

tests.name: hash
tests.template: {% for c in collection %}{{ c[0] }} {{ c[1] }} {% endfor %}

tests.name: empty array with default block
tests.template: {% for img in empty_things.array %}{{ img.url }} {% else %}no images{% endfor %}

tests.name: break
tests.template: {% for tag in product.tags %}{% if tag == 'sports' %}{% break %}{% else %}{{ tag }} {% endif %}{% else %}no images{% endfor %}

tests.name: continue
tests.template: {% for tag in product.tags %}{% if tag == 'sports' %}{% continue %}{% else %}{{ tag }} {% endif %}{% else %}no images{% endfor %}

tests.name: slice, just stop
tests.template: {% for tag in product.tags | slice: stop=1 %}{{ tag }} {% endfor %}

tests.name: slice, just start
tests.template: {% for tag in product.tags | slice: start=1 %}{{ tag }} {% endfor %}

tests.name: iterate an empty array
tests.template: {% for item in empty_things.array %}{{ item }}{% endfor %}

tests.name: iterate an empty array with default
tests.template: {% for item in empty_things.array %}{{ item }}{% else %}foo{% endfor %}

tests.name: lookup a filter from an outer context
tests.template: {% for tag in product.tags %}{{ tag | upcase }} {% endfor %}

tests.name: assign inside loop
tests.template: {% for tag in product.tags %}{% assign x = tag %}{% endfor %}{{ x }}

tests.name: blank empty loops
tests.template: {% for i in (0..10) %}  {% endfor %}

tests.name: undefined
tests.template: {% for tag in nosuchthing %}{{ tag }}{% endfor %}

tests.name: share outer scope
tests.template: {% assign foo = 'hello' %}{% for x in (1..3) %}{% assign foo = x %}{% endfor %}{{ foo }}

tests.name: loop over a string literal
tests.template: {% for i in 'hello' %}{{ i }} {% endfor %}

tests.name: loop over an empty string
tests.template: {% for i in '' %}{{ i }} {% endfor %}

tests.name: loop over a string variable
tests.template: {% for i in foo %}{{ i }} {% endfor %}

tests.name: loop over a non-iterable object
tests.template: {% for i in x %}{{ i }} {% endfor %}

tests.name: optional index binding
tests.template: {% for x, index in foo %}({{ x }},{{ index }}) {% endfor %}

tests.name: optional array binding
tests.template: {% for x, index, array in foo %}({{ x }},{{ index }},{{ array }}) {% endfor %}

tests.name: excess parameters are ignored
tests.template: {% for x, index, array, y in foo %}({{ x }},{{ index }}) {% endfor %}
